Don’t Miss Out: Sangamon County’s 54% ROI Tax Lien Auction

Click Here to Get Dustin Hahn’s Tax Lien and Deed FREE Mini-Course

Are you seeking high returns on your investments? Sangamon County, Illinois, is hosting its annual tax lien auction on November 8, 2024, offering an opportunity to earn up to 54% returns over three years. This auction provides a strong investment option for those looking to grow their portfolios through real estate-backed tax lien certificates.

Understanding Tax Lien Certificates

A tax lien certificate allows investors to pay off a property owner’s overdue taxes. In return, the investor earns interest on the amount paid, which accrues over time. If the property owner does not repay the taxes plus interest within a specified redemption period (36 months in Sangamon County), the investor can request a tax deed to take ownership of the property.

Key Benefits:

  • Interest Rate: Earn up to 54% over the three-year redemption period.
  • Ownership Potential: If the lien is not redeemed, investors can petition for full ownership of the property through a tax deed.

Sangamon County Tax Lien Auction Details

Date of Sale: November

Location: Sangamon County Complex, Room 302, 200 S. Ninth St., Springfield, IL 62701

Required Documents for Registration:

  • Tax Sale Buyer Certification and Registration Form
  • Vendor Information and ACH Form
  • Bank verification letter
  • Completed W-9
  • $200 deposit check for registration fee
  • Optional: An additional $200 for the tax list

How to Participate in the Sangamon County Tax Lien Auction

To participate in the Sangamon County Tax Lien Auction, you need to complete and submit the required documents by the registration deadline. On the auction day, check in at the Sangamon County Board Chamber with a signed check payable to “Sangamon County Collector.”

Bidding Process:

  • Starting Interest Rate: 9%
  • Bid Method: The auction follows a bid-down process, where the lowest interest rate offered wins the lien.
  • Random Selection: In cases of multiple matching bids, a random selection is used to determine the winner.
  • Interest: The penalty interest is added every six months for up to three years, allowing you to potentially earn 54% ROI if the lien remains unpaid.

Frequently Asked Questions

1. What is the redemption period for tax lien certificates in Sangamon County?

The redemption period is 36 months. If the property owner does not repay the taxes with interest during this time, the investor can request a tax deed.

2. How much can I earn from a tax lien certificate in Sangamon County?

You can earn up to 54% ROI over three years, with interest rates added every six months.

3. What documents are required for registration?

To register, submit a Tax Sale Buyer Certification and Registration Form, Vendor Information and ACH Form, Bank verification letter, completed W-9, and a $200 deposit check for the registration fee.

4. Is there a refund for the deposit if I do not win any bids?

Yes, if you participate in the auction but do not successfully win any bids, your deposit will be refunded.
